name: City Food Equipment - Lombard, IL - New & Used Restaurant Equipment & Kitchen Supply Store
old_description: City Food Equipment - Lombard, IL - New and Used Restaurant Equipment & Kitchen Supply Store
about:
City Food Equipment operates a 45,000-square-foot store and showroom in Lombard, Illinois, a village in DuPage County about 22 miles west of Chicago. The facility is open to the public six days a week, offering wholesale pricing to both food-service professionals and home cooks.

The company stocks new and used commercial restaurant equipment from brands such as Hobart, Vulcan, True Manufacturing, and Manitowoc, with up to 1,000 pieces on display at any time. An in-house team of technicians inspects, repairs, and refurbishes each used unit before it reaches the sales floor, a process the company says covers meat-processing, deli, and bakery machinery. The showroom also carries thousands of smallwares and supplies for front- and back-of-house needs.

Customers include restaurants, bars, bakeries, delis, catering operations, and meat-processing facilities, as well as individual home chefs. The product range spans cooking equipment (ranges, fryers, ovens, griddles, charbroilers), refrigeration, meat-processing tools (grinders, slicers, saws, mixers, stuffers), and bakery mixers and dividers.

City Food Equipment describes itself as one of the nation's largest used-restaurant-equipment dealers and highlights its certified technicians who refurbish Hobart planetary mixers to original manufacturer specifications. The company emphasizes its rigorous restoration process and the breadth of inventory available for immediate purchase.
